request: Copying a fixture into a workspace must keep a symbolic link that resolves inside the fixture, including when a later overlay carries the same link, while a link that is absolute or that leaves the fixture is still dropped.

defects.description: Own-history fix adf36c5e4c (2026-10-15): fix(bench): copy fixture symlinks that stay inside the fixture

trigger.input:
printf %s '' | base64 -d > internal/bench/copytree_test.go
if go test -count=1 -run '^(TestCopyTreeKeepsSymlinksAndOverlaysThem|TestCopyTreeSkipsLinksThatLeaveTheFixture)$' ./internal/bench >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo probe: pass; else echo probe: fail; fi

defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
